text:
Marcus: Quick sync  Starlane S3 SoC team asked for a joint perf/W runbook + kernel tuning notes. They want us to validate numbers for a marketplace blurb. Can we scope this week?
Sophia: Sounds good. We should define: workload, quant levels, power collection method, and an independence check (external meter).
Marcus: Proposed workload: Llama-13B int8/q4/q8 (we'll fallback to 7B if OOM), seq=1024, scenario = streaming token generation at batch sizes 1/8. Metrics: tokens/sec per watt, p95 latency, and distribution of per-core CPU/GPU power.
Raj: On kernel side: cpufreq=performance, disable turbo boost for baseline, set transparent hugepages=always, reserve 64GB hugepage pool, irqbalance off and manual IRQ pinning for NIC/PCIe. Also set iommu=pt if they use passthrough.
Anya: Data governance: we need a short NDA addendum for telemetry + a signed data retention window (30 days). @legal-bot, can you flag required language?
legal-bot: Suggestion: add clause for aggregated metrics only in public materials; raw per-core traces restricted and only shared under S3-specific DLAs. Legal to draft.
Lia: Marketing timeline: once we verify numbers and get logo approval, we need at least 10 business days to prep marketplace entry + press coordination.
Marcus: Scheduling: can we do a local dry-run Tue 09:00 PT to exercise scripts and CSV ingestion, then partner lab sweep Wed-Thu? Dry-run will only run a single q4 pass.
Sophia: +1 dry-run. I'll own the harness verification. Can we provide Starlane a trimmed-down smoke script to sanity-check before dry-run?
bench-bot: Uploaded sample smoke script: https://internal.redwood/bench/starlane/smoke_starlane.sh (private).
Marcus: Example smoke we'll send:
```
#!/bin/bash
./run_bench \\--model llama-13b \\--seq 1024 \\--quant q4 \\--batch 1 \\--duration 120 \\--telemetry ipmi,csv \
```
Raj: Measurement plan details: warmup = 120s; steady-state = 6 x 5min windows; sample power via IPMI every 2s (if available) and cross-check with external Owon meter every 10s for final verification. We'll compute 5% trimmed mean of power per window.
Sophia: Also capture GPU kernel counters for tail latency analysis and include a short perf counter list in runbook.
Marcus: Good call. Raj, can you prepare the kernel patchset + a revert script and drop into bench repo by Monday EOD?
Raj: Will open PR with two configs: starlane/s3-baseline.conf and starlane/s3-tuned.conf. Revert instructions included.
Anya: I'll draft the runbook (kernel knobs, telemetry schema, CSV columns we expect, file naming conventions) and include an appendix with the exact power aggregation formula we agreed on. Also will attach the NDA addendum and retention clause.
Jenna: Once numbers are verified, Marketing will need the final CSV summary + short one-paragraph boilerplate from Starlane for the marketplace listing. We'll also request a high-res logo with trademark usage terms.
Marcus: Partner contact: Evan at evan@starlane.com. I'll intro Evan to Anya + Raj and CC Jenna + Legal after we confirm schedule.
Lia: One more ops note: ensure NTP is synced on partner machines and collection host, and capture kernel version + bios/fw IDs in run artifacts.
Raj: We'll collect uname -a, lspci -vvv, dmidecode, firmware versions, and the ipmi sensor dump as part of the artifact bundle.
Sophia: Can everyone confirm dry-run Tue 09:00 PT?
Marcus: +1
Raj: +1
Anya: +1
Lia: +1
bench-bot: Dry-run scheduled: 2026-03-31T16:00:00Z (auto-scheduled).
Marcus: Thanks. I'll post the partner-facing checklist here before sending the intro. If anything else pops up, drop it here and I'll triage.
